d:
Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has announced that he will visit the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya.
His announcement has triggered a fresh political debate in Uttar Pradesh.
The BJP has questioned Akhilesh Yadav’s stand and targeted him over the Ram Mandir issue.
The political exchange comes amid the larger debate over Ayodhya and the temple.
